acceptance_rule: One designated accepted trajectory per frozen model-task-condition cell. Failed or partial Gemini and Mistral attempts were excluded by recovery provenance, not outcome. DeepSeek accepted existing same-provider cells plus exact missing-cell recovery only.

accepted_run_sources.accepted: GPT-4.1 public_health, critical_infrastructure, crisis_communication; DeepSeek available cells in the same domains; all GPT-5.4 and Claude diagnostic cells
GPT-4.1 cyber, disaster, governance except one missing cell; DeepSeek disaster and governance cells
all 180 Gemini Google Vertex cells and all 180 Mistral Venice cells
30 DeepSeek cyber cells plus seven exact gaps

execution_amendments: Agent horizon reduced from 8 to 6 turns before canonical data for budget.
Turn 6 reserved for forced submit_final_plan after a noncanonical pilot.
API-level parallel_tool_calls removed; the harness executes at most one tool call per turn.
Stale GPT-5 diagnostic endpoint replaced before canonical data with GPT-5.4.
Gemini accepted rerun used Google Vertex with reasoning disabled; malformed tool-call outputs were retained as model behavior.
Mistral Small 3.2 accepted rerun used Venice after Mistral and Parasail failed compatibility and DeepInfra was operationally overloaded.
DeepSeek remained on DeepInfra; only missing cells were recovered with bounded retries.
